reasoning: By the pigeonhole principle, placing 19 pigeons into 18 holes with each hole holding at most one pigeon is impossible. If each of the 18 holes can contain at most one pigeon, the maximum number of pigeons that can be placed is 18. Since we have 19 pigeons, at least one hole would need to contain two pigeons, violating the constraint. Therefore the problem is unsatisfiable (UNSAT).
